capabilities: Save and switch named workspace layout sessions
Organize sessions into groups, rename, reorder, and bulk-delete
Restore per-session version history and export/import session backups
Control sessions from the status bar and custom hotkeys
Load and write sessions from note frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a project or task manager; it saves and restores window layouts, not note content.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README documents sync-compatibility tradeoffs (data.json storage, per-device version history) and multi-device merge behavior.
problem: Obsidian gives no good way to save multiple named layout sessions, switch between them from the keyboard, keep per-session history, or carry sessions across devices.

relations.evidence: Use BRAT if you want to test unreleased changes directly from GitHub.

summary: Workspace session manager that saves Obsidian layouts as named sessions, with grouping, hotkey switching, version history, backups, and status bar controls.
